name: G-G Parameter-Risk Pool
description: A byte-frozen benchmark of 600 encoded tool-call attack/benign vectors against MCP-style agents (400 published in this release; 200 held-out, sealed and not distributed), plus an open, in-process reference evidence-view guard and a fully reproducible evaluation harness. Licensing: the benchmark data/vectors are licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0 (the record license). The reference guard source code is licensed under the Elastic License 2.0 (Elastic-2.0); see LICENSE, DATA-LICENSE and NOTICE in the archive. This archive is an individual submission. It is not an IETF/RFC standard, and it does not imply IETF endorsement or certification. The related Internet-Draft and Zenodo records are referenced below. Scope note: the headline result (95.0% attack interception, 0.0% FPR on the published 200-vector development split) is for the OPEN in-process reference guard (policy + schema-widened rules + evidence views). It does not include a cross-process verifier or signed-receipt enforcement; that scope must not be conflated with the fail-closed signed-receipt layer.
